name: Death to the Executioner
summary: Clugfist asks you to face Morg, the ogre guarding the way out of Twilight. He wants Morg’s mace returned to Bolder’ok.

sections.title: A Way Out
sections.body: Clugfist, in Bolder’ok, asks you to take on Morg in the Twilight Shroud. The executioner is an ogre nearly as large as Clugfist, and Clugfist says he relies on smaller allies for protection. Bring the mace back to him, and Twilight’s Hammer will know the ogres challenge them no more.

sections.title: Bolder’ok’s Answer
sections.body: Crag’rog says you have joined him in the fight, and Clugfist asks what you bring. Morg is dead, and Clugfist praises your tricks. He says Twilight’s Hammer has crumpled beneath Bolder’ok’s might, and the ogres are free.

faq.answer: Morg is an executioner in the Twilight Shroud, an ogre nearly as large as Clugfist.

faq.q: Why does Clugfist want Morg dead?
faq.answer: Clugfist says Morg stands in the way as he leaves Twilight, and that Morg relies on smaller allies for protection.

faq.q: What does Clugfist want you to bring back?
faq.answer: Clugfist wants Morg’s Executioner’s Mace returned to him in Bolder’ok.
Morg is in the Twilight Shroud.

angles.text: As a tauren, Clugfist calls you a tiny tauren full of tricks after Morg is dead.
